Stories also expose them to diverse cultures and perspectives, cultivating open-mindedness and tolerance. Beyond that, tales nurture creativity and emotional intelligence, helping children navigate complex feelings. By engaging with various narratives, kids can learn problem-solving, resilience, and the beauty of storytelling, setting a solid foundation for their overall growth and development.

p3_questions.question: Why do most children like listening to stories before bedtime?
p3_questions.answer: Most children enjoy listening to bedtime stories as it provides them with a sense of comfort and security. The soothing tone of the storyteller helps them unwind after a long day, creating a peaceful environment that aids in falling asleep more easily. Furthermore, stories spark their imagination and transport them to magical worlds, enhancing their creativity and linguistic skills. Through the characters and plots, children also grasp valuable moral lessons, ensuring holistic development. Overall, the ritual of bedtime stories not only fosters a love for reading but also strengthens the bond between children and their caregivers.

p3_questions.question: What are the benefits of bedtime stories for children?
p3_questions.answer: Bedtime stories offer an array of advantages to children. They stimulate their imagination and creativity, transporting them to magical worlds beyond their reality. Moreover, these stories help children develop crucial language skills, enhance vocabulary, and encourage a love for reading from a tender age. Furthermore, the bonding experience created through bedtime stories fosters strong emotional connections between parents and children, nurturing trust and intimacy in their relationship. Overall, bedtime stories play a vital role in a child's cognitive, emotional, and social development, making them a cherished and valuable tradition in many families.

p3_questions.question: What kind of stories do children like?
p3_questions.answer: Children often enjoy stories that involve adventures, magical creatures, and brave characters. These tales can transport them to fascinating worlds where anything is possible. From fairy tales with princesses and dragons to superhero adventures with amazing powers, young readers are drawn to stories that ignite their imagination. Additionally, children often appreciate humorous stories that make them giggle and easy-to- follow narratives with colorful illustrations that bring the characters to life. Overall, a mix of fantasy, humor, and engaging characters tends to captivate the hearts of young audiences.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a time when the electricity suddenly when off
you_should_say: What you did during the time
And explain how you felt about it
topics.summary_zh: 停电发生在 2 个月前周五晚上 8 点的家里，当时在帮妈妈烤饼干，持续了1.5 小时。我们用厨房的应急灯照明，把没烤好的饼干放进保温箱，然后坐在客厅里吃已经烤好的饼干，听妈妈讲她小时候停电的经历，我觉得这次停电让我更了解妈妈了。bond(建立亲密关系).
topics.sample_en: The sudden power outage occurred two months ago, on a Friday evening at 8 p. m. I was in my home kitchen, helping my mom bake chocolate chip cookies—we’d already mixed the dough and put some on the baking tray, and the oven was heating up when all the lights went out. The kitchen, which had been bright with the oven light, turned dark immediately. It lasted for one and a half hours. My mom, who stayed calm, took out an emergency light from the cabinet—we keep it for situations like this. We checked the oven: since it had no power, we couldn’t continue baking, so we put the unbaked dough into an insulated box to keep it fresh. We also turned off the main switch to avoid any safety issues when the power came back. During the outage, we sat in the living room with the emergency light on. We ate the few cookies we’d baked earlier—they were still warm—and my mom told me about her childhood power cuts. She said when she was my age, her family lived in a small town, and when the electricity went off, her dad would tell stories by candlelight. She even mentioned that she used to collect fireflies in jars to make “natural lights.”. I felt a deep sense of connection with my mom. Normally, we talk about daily things like homework or groceries, but this time we shared memories and stories I’d never heard before. The outage didn’t ruin our baking plan; instead, it gave us a precious chance to bond. I realized small, unexpected moments can bring people closer. outage(停电，断电). dough(面团). oven(烤箱). emergency light(应急灯). insulated box(保温箱). safety issues(安全问题). firefly(萤火虫). natural(自然的). precious(珍贵的).

p3_questions.question: How did people manage to live without electricity in the ancient world?
p3_questions.answer: Back in the ancient world, people relied on natural sources for light, like candles or oil lamps, and used fire for warmth and cooking. They adapted to the rhythms of nature, going to bed when it got dark and waking up with the sunrise. Without electricity, communities were closely connected, often gathering around fires for storytelling or celebrations. People found innovative ways to preserve food, using techniques like smoking, salting, or fermenting. Life without electricity fostered stronger interpersonal relationships and a deeper connection with the environment.

p3_questions.question: Which is better, electric cars or petrol cars?
p3_questions.answer: In my opinion, electric cars are a more environmentally friendly option compared to petrol cars. They produce zero emissions, which helps reduce air pollution and fight climate change. Moreover, electric cars have lower maintenance costs and are quieter to drive, providing a smoother and more peaceful driving experience. However, petrol cars still have advantages in terms of longer driving range and faster refueling times. Ultimately, both types have their own pros and cons, but with the increasing focus on sustainability, electric cars seem to have the edge for a cleaner future.

p3_questions.question: Do you think electric bicycles will replace ordinary bicycles in the future?
p3_questions.answer: I believe electric bicycles might not completely replace traditional bicycles in the future. While e-bikes offer convenience and assist with long commutes or hilly terrains, many cycling enthusiasts enjoy the physical exercise and simplicity of a traditional bike ride. Moreover, environmental concerns and the pleasure derived from pedaling will likely ensure the continued popularity of ordinary bicycles. Instead, I envision electric bicycles becoming a complementary option, catering to different needs and preferences in the diverse world of cycling.

p3_questions.question: Which is better, electric bicycles or ordinary bicycles?
p3_questions.answer: I believe that electric bicycles and ordinary bicycles each have their own advantages. While electric bicycles are convenient for longer distances and hilly terrains, ordinary bicycles promote physical exercise and are environmentally friendly. Personally, I prefer ordinary bicycles for short commutes and leisure rides as they help me stay active and enjoy the outdoors. On the other hand, electric bicycles could be a better option for people with mobility issues or those who require assistance when riding uphill. The choice between the two depends on individual preferences and needs.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a good habit your friend has and you want to develop
you_should_say: When/how you notices the good habit
And explain how you will develop the some habit
topics.summary_zh: 我的朋友陈阳是个自律的男生，对自己要求很高。他的好习惯是每周三次去健身房运动，每次 1 小时，主要练跑步和力量训练。我大一时发现的—— 那时大家常熬夜打游戏，他却坚持晚上 7 点去健身房，还会在朋友圈分享运动打卡照。我想培养这个习惯：先和陈阳约好一起去，制定每周一、三、五的运动计划，每次先跑 20 分钟，再做简单的力量训练，运动后记录感受，激励自己坚持。
topics.sample_en: My friend Chen Yang is a highly self-disciplined boy who sets strict standards for himself. He never procrastinates on tasks—whether it’s finishing homework or preparing for exams—and he always follows his plans carefully. His good habit is working out at the gym three times a week, for one hour each time. He focuses on running to improve his endurance and strength training (like lifting light weights) to build up his body. He says regular exercise keeps him energetic and helps him concentrate better on his studies. I noticed this habit when we were freshmen in college. Most of our roommates stayed up late playing video games or scrolling through social media, but Chen Yang stuck to his routine: every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 7 p. m., he’d put on his sportswear and go to the gym. He also shared his workout check-in photos on WeChat, which showed his consistency. To develop this habit, I’ll first make a plan to go to the gym with Chen Yang—having a partner will keep me from skipping. My initial plan is 20 minutes of running followed by simple strength training, then gradually increasing the time. After each workout, I’ll write down how I feel (like “tired but energetic”) to motivate myself. Over time, I hope this becomes a natural part of my week. 1. self-disciplined(自律的) 2. strict standards(严格标准) 3. procrastinate(拖延) 4. work out(运动) 5. endurance(耐力) 6. strength training(力量训练) 7. freshmen(大一新生) 8. routine(日常规律) 9. consistency(连贯性) 10. motivate(激励).

p3_questions.question: Do you think a person’s good habits would influence those around him/her? How?
p3_questions.answer: Absolutely, I believe a person's good habits can greatly influence those around them. For instance, if someone consistently practices healthy habits like exercising regularly or maintaining a positive attitude, it can inspire others to do the same. This positive behavior often creates a ripple effect in their social circle or workplace, leading others to adopt similar habits. I personally strive to set a good example by practicing good habits like punctuality and active listening, which I hope motivates my friends and colleagues to cultivate similar positive behaviors.

p3_questions.question: What can we do to get rid of bad habit?
p3_questions.answer: To overcome a bad habit, firstly, self-awareness is key. Identifying triggers and understanding why the habit occurs is crucial. Secondly, setting realistic goals and creating a plan is essential. For example, replacing smoking with healthier habits like meditation or exercise. Thirdly, seeking support from friends, family, or professionals can provide encouragement and accountability. Lastly, celebrating small victories along the way boosts motivation. Remember, change takes time and effort, so be patient and kind to yourself throughout the process.

p3_questions.question: Why do we develop bad habit?
p3_questions.answer: We may develop bad habits due to various reasons. Sometimes stress from work or personal life can lead to habits like emotional eating or excessive shopping. Additionally, societal influences play a role, such as peer pressure or media influence promoting unhealthy habits. Moreover, lack of awareness or self- discipline can also contribute to the formation of bad habits. It's essential to identify these triggers and work on developing healthier coping mechanisms to break free from negative patterns. Ultimately, self- reflection and determination are key in overcoming bad habits and leading a more balanced lifestyle.

p3_questions.question: What should parents do to help their children develop good habit ？
p3_questions.answer: To assist their children in forming positive habits, parents can actively engage in setting a good example through their own behavior. By incorporating healthy routines into their daily lives, such as exercising regularly or maintaining a balanced diet, parents can influence their children to follow suit. Moreover, parents should communicate openly with their children about the importance of good habits and the benefits they bring in the long term. Encouraging children to take part in decision-making processes regarding their habits also fosters a sense of ownership and responsibility. This active involvement helps children internalize the value of creating and sustaining positive habits.

p3_questions.question: What good habit should children have？
p3_questions.answer: A great habit that children should develop is the practice of mindfulness. Encouraging kids to focus on the present moment can help enhance their cognitive abilities and emotional well-being. By teaching them mindfulness techniques such as deep breathing or meditation, children can learn to manage stress and improve their concentration. This habit can provide them with a tool to navigate the challenges of growing up in today's fast-paced world. Moreover, mindfulness can foster empathy and kindness towards others, promoting a harmonious environment both at school and home.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a creative person (e.g. an artist, a musician, etc) you admire
you_should_say: And explain why you think he/she is creative
topics.summary_zh: 我钦佩的创作者是日本动画导演宫崎骏。我小时候通过观看动画电影《龙猫》认识他，被影片中温馨的画面和奇幻的故事吸引。他的最大成就是创立吉卜力工作室，创作了《千与千寻》等多部经典动画，其中《千与千寻》还获得奥斯卡最佳动画长片奖。我认为他有创造力，是因为他坚持手绘动画、擅长将环保与成长等深刻主题融入奇幻故事，且塑造的角色极具感染力。
topics.sample_en: The creative person I deeply admire is Hayao Miyazaki, a legendary Japanese animation director. He’s famous for making heartfelt, visually stunning animated films that appeal to both children and adults.​. I first knew him when I was around 8 years old. My mother showed me his film My Neighbor Totoro—I was instantly drawn to the soft, hand-drawn scenes of forests, the cute, magical Totoro character, and the warm story about sisterhood. After that, I watched more of his works, like Spirited Away and Howl’s Moving Castle, and gradually became a fan.​. His greatest achievement is co-founding Studio Ghibli, a studio that produced many of his masterpieces. Among them, Spirited Away is the most iconic—it became a global box office hit and won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature in 2003, making it the first non-English animated film to get this honor.​. What makes him creative is his unique approach. Unlike many animators who rely on 3D technology, he insists on hand-drawing most frames, adding tiny, vivid details like swaying grass or raindrops that make scenes feel alive. He also weaves deep themes—such as environmental protection and the courage to grow—into magical stories, turning simple animations into works that make people think. His ability to mix fantasy with real-life emotions makes his creations truly one-of-a-kind. Animation director(动画导演). Hand-drawn(手绘的). Masterpiece(杰作). Co-found(共同创立). Box office hit(票房热门作品). p3_questions.question: What can we do to help old children learn music?
p3_questions.answer: To help older children learn music effectively, we could organize music workshops where they can explore different instruments and genres. Additionally, providing access to online tutorials and interactive learning platforms can enhance their musical skills. Encouraging them to join youth orchestras or bands can also foster their passion for music while allowing them to collaborate with their peers. Furthermore, offering music scholarships or grants can make music education more accessible to those with limited resources. Ultimately, combining traditional teaching methods with modern technology and peer collaboration can greatly benefit older children in learning music.

p3_questions.question: What can we do to help children keep creative?
p3_questions.answer: To assist children in nurturing their creativity, we can encourage them to explore various artistic pursuits such as painting, writing stories, or composing music. Additionally, engaging them in activities that involve problem-solving, critical thinking, and teamwork, like puzzles or group projects, can stimulate their creative thinking. Providing them with a supportive environment where mistakes are viewed as part of the learning process can also boost their confidence to think outside the box. Finally, exposing children to a diverse range of experiences, whether through travel, books, or interactions with people from different backgrounds, can broaden their perspectives and inspire new ideas.

p3_questions.question: Do you think pictures and videos in news reports are important?
p3_questions.answer: Presenting a comprehensive view, I believe that pictures and videos play a crucial role in news reports. They provide a visual representation that can evoke emotions and make stories more engaging. For instance, powerful images can convey the impact of a natural disaster far more effectively than just words. Additionally, videos offer a dynamic dimension to news, giving viewers a better understanding of complex events. Therefore, visuals in news reports are not merely important but integral in conveying information effectively and fostering empathy among audiences.

p3_questions.question: How do artists acquire inspiration?
p3_questions.answer: Artists find inspiration in various ways. I believe that for many artists, nature plays a vital role in sparking creativity. The beauty of landscapes, the colors of a sunset, or the sound of ocean waves can evoke strong emotions and lead to artistic expression. Additionally, personal experiences, emotions, and interactions with diverse cultures can also serve as sources of inspiration. Furthermore, artists often seek inspiration from other art forms, such as literature, music, or historical events, to create unique and meaningful creations. Ultimately, inspiration can come from anywhere, allowing artists to transform ordinary moments into extraordinary art.

p3_questions.question: Do you think children should learn to place musical instruments?
p3_questions.answer: Absolutely, I believe that children should be encouraged to learn to play musical instruments. Music education not only helps children develop creativity and discipline but also enhances their cognitive skills. For instance, playing instruments like the piano or violin can improve hand-eye coordination and boost their concentration levels. Moreover, learning music can also be a great way for children to express themselves and build self-confidence. Overall, playing musical instruments can have a positive impact on children's overall growth and development.

topics.sample_en: An important old thing in my family is my grandpa’s old radio. It’s a black plastic radio, not very big—about the size of a book. The buttons on it are a bit faded, but it can still play sound if we put batteries in it. My grandpa received this radio in 1993 when he retired from his job at a factory. The factory gave it to all retired workers as a souvenir to thank them for their years of hard work. My grandpa was very happy when he got it; he said it was a meaningful gift for his retirement life. We have kept it for 30 years. In the past, every evening after dinner, the whole family would sit around the radio. My grandpa liked to listen to news, my grandma enjoyed traditional operas, and I would listen to children’s stories. Now, we have phones and TVs, but we still keep the radio. This radio is important to our family because it recorded many happy evenings of our family. It’s a reminder of my grandpa’s working years and the simple but warm life we used to have. Every time we see it, we think of those peaceful moments together, which makes it a precious treasure for us. plastic(塑料的). faded(褪色的). battery(电池). retire(退休). souvenir(纪念品). traditional opera(传统戏曲). record(记录). reminder(提醒物). peaceful(平静的). precious treasure(珍贵的宝物).

p3_questions.question: What are the differences between the things old people keep and those young people keep?
p3_questions.answer: As we age, the items we treasure reflect our experiences and values. Older people often hold onto sentimental belongings like heirlooms, family photos, and antiques, which carry memories from the past. On the other hand, young individuals tend to keep up with current trends, holding onto gadgets, fashion items, and social media accounts, reflecting their connection to the modern world. While the elderly cherish nostalgia and tradition, the younger generation focuses on innovation and staying connected in a fast-paced society.

p3_questions.question: Why do people keep old things?
p3_questions.answer: People often hold on to old belongings for sentimental reasons or for their historical significance. Personally, for many individuals, keeping old items is a way to cherish memories from the past. Vintage items can also hold value in terms of nostalgia or as collectibles. Moreover, some individuals appreciate the quality and craftsmanship of older products compared to modern mass-produced items. In a world of constantly changing trends, old things can provide a sense of stability and connection to the past, fostering a deeper appreciation for heritage and tradition.

p3_questions.question: What kind of old things do people like to keep?
p3_questions.answer: People often cherish old photographs as they hold nostalgic memories, connecting them to the past and their loved ones. Antique jewelry and family heirlooms are also treasured items due to their sentimental value and historical significance. Some individuals keep vintage vinyl records or classic books to appreciate the artistry and craftsmanship of a bygone era. Furthermore, vintage clothing or retro items are preserved as they evoke a sense of fashion history and personal style evolution. All these old possessions serve as tangible links to the past, preserving stories and traditions for future generations.

p3_questions.question: Why do some people prefer to travel in their own country rather than going abroad?
p3_questions.answer: Some individuals prefer exploring their own country instead of traveling abroad for various reasons. Firstly, domestic travel can be more convenient and cost-effective compared to international trips. Secondly, people might have a deeper sense of connection to their own culture and traditions, making local travel more appealing. Additionally, exploring one's country allows individuals to appreciate the diversity and beauty within their own borders. Lastly, domestic travel enables people to support local businesses and promote tourism within their own community. 1. What would happen if no preparation were made before the trip If no preparation were made before a trip, it could lead to a series of challenging situations. Without proper planning, one might encounter difficulties like overpacking, missing essential documents, or running out of money unexpectedly. Additionally, not researching destinations could result in getting lost, communication barriers, or being unaware of local customs. Proper preparation is crucial to ensure a smooth and enjoyable travel experience. By planning ahead, one can avoid unnecessary stress, save time, and make the most of their journey. 2. What should we prepare before a trip Before embarking on a trip, it is important to make several preparations to ensure a smooth journey. Firstly, researching the destination's customs and culture is crucial to show respect and avoid misunderstandings. Additionally, packing essentials such as clothing suitable for the location's climate, travel documents, and necessary medications is key. Moreover, making necessary bookings for accommodations and transportation beforehand can save time and prevent last-minute hassles. Lastly, it is wise to inform a trusted friend or family member about your travel itinerary for safety reasons. By taking these steps, you can enhance your travel experience and minimize potential challenges.

p3_questions.question: Why do people like traveling?
p3_questions.answer: People cherish traveling for various reasons. For me, exploring new places unveils a tapestry of cultures, each thread weaving a unique story of traditions and beliefs. The thrill of tasting exotic cuisines and witnessing breathtaking landscapes invigorates my soul. Furthermore, travel fosters personal growth by stepping out of comfort zones and embracing the unknown. It is a canvas where memories are painted with the vibrant colors of shared experiences and lifelong bonds. In essence, traveling is not merely a journey of miles but a transformation of the heart and mind.

p3_questions.question: What kind of people like to visit natural places?
p3_questions.answer: Well, I think those who appreciate nature, love the outdoors, and seek tranquility and beauty usually enjoy visiting natural attractions. These people may include outdoor enthusiasts, nature lovers, environmentalists, and those who value sustainable living and eco-friendly practices. Whether it's hiking in the mountains, bird watching in the forest, or relaxing by the beach, visiting natural attractions allows people to become one with their environment, experience biodiversity, and appreciate the wonders of the natural world.

p3_questions.question: What are the differences between a natural place and a city?
p3_questions.answer: The differences between a natural place and a city are vast and encompass various aspects such as environment, infrastructure, lifestyle, and atmosphere. Natural places, such as forests, mountains, rivers, and parks, are characterized by abundant greenery, wildlife, and natural landscapes. They offer opportunities for outdoor recreation, solitude, and immersion in nature's beauty. In contrast, cities are urbanized areas densely populated with buildings, roads, and infrastructure. They are centers of commerce, culture, and social activity, offering diverse amenities, services, and entertainment options. While cities provide convenience and connectivity, natural places offer respite from urban life and opportunities for relaxation, reflection, and rejuvenation.

p3_questions.question: Do you think that going to the park is the only way to get close to nature?
p3_questions.answer: No, going to the park is not the only way to get close to nature, although parks can provide accessible and convenient opportunities for urban dwellers to experience natural environments. In addition to parks, people can explore a variety of natural places such as forests, beaches, mountains, and wildlife reserves, depending on their preferences and interests. Nature trails, botanical gardens, camping grounds, and nature reserves are other options for experiencing the outdoors and connecting with nature. Furthermore, engaging in outdoor activities such as hiking, birdwatching, picnicking, or nature photography can enhance the experience of being close to nature and foster a deeper appreciation for the environment.

p3_questions.question: What can people gain from going to natural places?
p3_questions.answer: People can gain numerous benefits from visiting natural places, including physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Being in natural environments has been linked to reduced stress, improved mood, and enhanced cognitive function. The fresh air, natural scenery, and tranquil surroundings promote relaxation, mindfulness, and a sense of calmness. Moreover, outdoor activities such as hiking, cycling, or swimming provide opportunities for physical exercise, cardiovascular health, and stress relief. Additionally, spending time in nature fosters a sense of connection to the environment, promotes environmental awareness, and encourages conservation efforts to protect natural habitats and biodiversity.

p3_questions.question: Are there any wild animals in the city?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, there are wild animals in some cities, although their presence and diversity may vary depending on factors such as urbanization, habitat availability, and human activity. Common urban wildlife species include birds, squirrels, raccoons, foxes, and occasionally larger mammals such as deer or coyotes(鸟类、 松鼠、浣熊、狐狸，偶尔还有较大的哺乳动物，如鹿或土狼). Urban parks, green spaces, and natural reserves may provide habitats for these animals, offering refuge and resources in an otherwise developed landscape. While encounters with urban wildlife can enrich people's experiences and foster appreciation for biodiversity, it is essential to promote coexistence and mitigate potential conflicts through responsible urban planning, wildlife management, and public education.

p3_questions.question: Do you think it is a good idea to let animals stay in local parks for people to see?
p3_questions.answer: Allowing animals to stay in local parks for people to see can be a positive idea under certain conditions, provided that it is done ethically, responsibly, and with consideration for animal welfare and conservation principles. Parks that serve as habitats for native wildlife can offer educational opportunities for visitors to learn about local ecosystems, biodiversity, and conservation efforts. However, it is crucial to ensure that the presence of animals in parks does not disrupt their natural behavior, compromise their well-being, or pose risks to public safety. Responsible management practices, such as habitat preservation, wildlife monitoring, and visitor education, can help create harmonious environments where people can appreciate wildlife responsibly and contribute to conservation efforts.

p3_questions.question: Why are there so few top athletes?
p3_questions.answer: There could be several reasons for the comparatively low number of top athletes. Firstly, the development of top athletes requires a combination of exceptional talent, rigorous training, and proper infrastructure. In some cases, the lack of access to high-quality training facilities, coaching, and resources may hinder the development of potential talents. Lastly, the intense competition in sports at the national and international levels makes it challenging for individuals to break through and reach the top. Overall, a combination of limited resources, cultural priorities, and intense competition contribute to the scarcity of top athletes.

p3_questions.question: What is the most popular sport in your country?
p3_questions.answer: In my country, China, the most popular sport is undoubtedly football, also known as soccer. Football has a massive following among people of all ages and is widely played and watched throughout the nation. The Chinese Super League has attracted numerous talented international players and has gained significant popularity in recent years. Football resonates with both urban and rural communities, with many people actively participating in amateur leagues and engaging in friendly matches. The popularity of football in China demonstrates its strong influence and passionate following among sports enthusiasts.

p3_questions.question: Is it easy to identify children's talents?
p3_questions.answer: Identifying children's talents can be a complex and challenging task. While some talents may be obvious from an early age, such as exceptional musical or artistic abilities, others may be less apparent. It's important for parents and educators to provide children with a wide range of opportunities to explore different interests and skills. This can involve exposing them to various activities such as sports, music, dance, science, and more. Through observation, encouragement, and guidance, adults can begin to recognize and nurture children's unique talents.

p3_questions.question: Is talent important in sports?
p3_questions.answer: Talent plays a significant role in sports, but it is not the sole determinant of success. While natural ability can provide certain advantages, hard work and dedication can often surpass talent alone. Talent may enable individuals to excel initially, but without effort and perseverance, it can be wasted. Sports require consistent practice, discipline, and a willingness to improve, irrespective of one's innate abilities. Moreover, athletes who possess determination, mental resilience, and strategic thinking can compensate for any lack of raw talent. Therefore, while talent can provide a head start, it is ultimately the combination of hard work, perseverance, and a strong mindset that determines an athlete's success in sports.

p3_questions.question: What qualities make an athlete?
p3_questions.answer: Several qualities contribute to making an athlete successful. Firstly, dedication and discipline are crucial. Athletes must be committed to their training regimen, showing up consistently and putting in the necessary effort. Secondly, physical fitness is essential. Athletes need to possess strength, speed, agility, and endurance specific to their sport. Thirdly, mental fortitude is vital. Athletes must have a strong mindset to overcome challenges, stay focused under pressure, and maintain motivation. Overall, a combination of physical abilities, mental toughness, and strong interpersonal skills makes a well-rounded athlete.

p3_questions.question: Should students have physical education and do sports at school?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, students should have physical education and participate in sports at school. Physical education and sports play a crucial role in promoting a healthy lifestyle and overall well-being. It helps students develop physical fitness, motor skills, and coordination. Engaging in sports also fosters teamwork, discipline, and perseverance, which are essential life skills. Overall, it is essential for students to have opportunities for physical education and sports as it contributes to their holistic development.

I knew I was doing wrong, but sitting on the swing, felt like I was on cloud nine(我超级 高兴)! The sky was crystal blue and the trees were green! Birds chirped happily all around. Wow, it was a sheer delight(真的太享受了)! I must have lingered on the swing for hours before I finally decided to return home as It was getting dark. All the routes around the swings seemed pretty much the same. I forgot from which path I came. I’d be lying if I told you I wasn’t panicked. I just randomly picked a route and went along. Oh, the buildings looked strange. I knew I was on the wrong path. As my mother always said, I was a naughty, but rather quick-minded kid! The minute I realized I was wrong, I returned back on the same road! Well, my parents would not know my whereabouts(我父母并不 知道我的去向) and I really didn’t know what I was supposed to do. Luckily, my neighbor took her son to the park to go on the same swings that evening! She saw me looking lonely and lost and took me home! I was dead certain I was gonna be punished but my mother just held me in her arms for a very long time.

p3_questions.question: Why do some people get lost more easily than others?
p3_questions.answer: Some people may be more prone to getting lost due to various factors such as their sense of direction, spatial awareness, memory, and attention to detail. Individuals with a strong sense of direction and good spatial awareness tend to have an easier time navigating their environment. On the other hand, those with poor memory or who are easily distracted may struggle to remember landmarks and maintain their bearings. Additionally, unfamiliarity with a particular area and lack of preparation can also lead to getting lost. Overall, multiple factors can contribute to why some people get lost more easily than others.

p3_questions.question: Do you think it is important to be able to read a map?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, I believe it is important to be able to read a map. While technology has made it easier to navigate, relying solely on devices such as GPS can be risky, as technology can fail. Being able to read a map is a basic life skill that can help you navigate unfamiliar places and assess situations better. It can also help you plan trips and find alternate routes in case of detours or closures. Additionally, reading a map provides a sense of independence and self-reliance, which can boost confidence and make a person more resourceful. Therefore, I think it's an essential skill worth learning.

p3_questions.question: Do you think it is important to do some preparation before you travel to new places?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, I think it is essential to do some preparation before traveling to new places. Firstly, research can help you understand the local culture, customs, and protocols beforehand, thus reducing any potential misunderstandings. Secondly, having knowledge of the destination's weather, geography, and transportation options can help you plan your trip better. Finally, preparation can also help you to avoid running into unexpected difficulties, such as booking accommodation in advance, getting necessary vaccinations, and obtaining required documents such as visas. Overall, doing thorough preparation before traveling can make the trip much more enjoyable and hassle-free.

p3_questions.question: How can people find their way when they are lost?
p3_questions.answer: People can find their way when they are lost by using various methods. One common way is to use a map or GPS device to determine their location and plot a course to their destination. Another option is to ask for directions from someone who is familiar with the area. In addition, people can look for landmarks or other recognizable features to help them get their bearings. Finally, in emergency situations, it may be necessary to use survival skills such as building a shelter or starting a fire until help arrives. With a combination of these techniques, even when lost, people can still find their way to safety.

p3_questions.question: Is a paper map still necessary?
p3_questions.answer: While paper maps may not be as commonly used in today's age of technology, they can still be necessary in certain situations. For example, when traveling to remote areas where GPS or mobile network coverage may be limited or non-existent, a paper map will come in handy. Similarly, when planning a trip and wanting to view the bigger picture, a paper map is a better option to get a sense of the overall geography and terrain. When technology fails, paper maps can provide a reliable backup and help navigate the way. Therefore, while not essential, having a paper map can still be very useful. While digital maps and GPS navigation systems have become increasingly popular, paper maps still hold value in certain situations. For example, paper maps can provide a broader view of an area and can be useful for planning longer trips or exploring multiple destinations. They also don't require electricity or internet connectivity. Additionally, some people enjoy the tactile experience of using a paper map. However, for day-to-day navigation, digital maps are often more convenient. Ultimately, whether or not a paper map is necessary depends on the individual's personal preferences and specific needs.

p3_questions.question: Why do some people have a good sense of direction?
p3_questions.answer: Some people have a good sense of direction due to a combination of factors, such as their visual memory, ability to read maps or other spatial cues, and experience navigating different environments. Additionally, some studies suggest that genetics may play a role in an individual's sense of direction. People who are regularly exposed to navigating unfamiliar environments, such as frequent travelers or outdoor enthusiasts, may also develop stronger spatial skills and a better sense of direction over time. Essentially, having a good sense of direction is often a result of a mix of inherent abilities, environmental factors, and practice.

p3_questions.question: How do people react when they get lost?
p3_questions.answer: When people get lost, their reactions can vary. Some individuals may panic and become anxious, while others may remain calm and attempt to retrace their steps or ask for directions. Feelings of frustration, confusion, and helplessness are common when someone realizes they are lost. In extreme cases, individuals may also experience physical symptoms such as sweating, increased heart rate, and trembling. Overall, how people react when they get lost depends on their personality, level of preparedness, and the severity of the situation. When people get lost, their reactions can vary depending on the situation and individual personality. Some people may become anxious or panicked, while others may remain calm and focused. In general, people may try to retrace their steps or seek help from others, such as asking for directions or using a map or GPS. They may also try to use landmarks or other visual cues to navigate their way back to a familiar location. Most importantly, it's important to stay safe and avoid taking unnecessary risks, such as wandering aimlessly or entering unsafe areas.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a movie you watched recently that you felt disappointed with
you_should_say: Why you decided to watch it
topics.summary_zh: .我最近看了一部中国电影《你好，李焕英》，让我感到很失望。我决定看这部电影，因为它自上映以来受到了很多人的关注和炒作。这部电影讲述了一个女儿穿越时空回到母亲去世前与她见面，并为她创造机会改变他们的生活的故事。
topics.sample_en: . I recently watched a Chinese movie called "Hi, Mom" (你好，李焕英) that left me feeling disappointed. I decided to watch this film because it had received a lot of attention and hype since its release. The movie tells the story of a daughter who travels back in time to meet her mother before she passed away and creates opportunities for her to change their lives together. One of the reasons why I didn't enjoy the movie was that it tackled very sensitive and complex themes but failed to address them appropriately. The representation of grief, loss, and coping mechanisms(应对机制) were oversimplified and lacked depth. The tone of the movie also felt inconsistent, jumping between comedic and sentimental scenes without much coherence. Furthermore, while the main actress's performance was impressive, the supporting roles felt flat. Some characters were underdeveloped and unrealistic, lacking layers. Lastly, although the film aimed to highlight the mother-daughter relationship, it lacked substantial conversations(实质性对话) and interactions between them. Instead, the movie heavily relied on flashbacks and expositions to convey emotions, leading to an unsatisfactory resolution. In conclusion, despite the strong performances, "Hi, Mom" failed to deliver the emotional weight it intended to. The lack of depth in addressing sensitive themes, inconsistent storytelling, and underdeveloped side characters left me feeling disappointed.

p3_questions.question: Should the director pay a lot of money to famous actors?
p3_questions.answer: I think this is a subjective issue. It depends on the budget of the project, the importance of the role, and the impact that the actor's star power could have on the film's success. While hiring renowned actors can bring attention and financial success to a film, it’s not always necessary. Sometimes, lesser-known actors can offer equally compelling performances without the high price tag. Ultimately, what matters most is the quality of the film and its ability to connect with audiences.

p3_questions.question: Why are Japanese animated films so popular?
p3_questions.answer: Japanese animated films, also known as anime, are popular due to their unique storytelling, stunning visual effects, and cultural appeal. Anime often explores deep, thought-provoking themes that resonate with audiences worldwide, such as love, loss, and the human condition. It incorporates various genres, from action-packed adventures to heartwarming romances, providing something for everyone. The intricate and detailed animation and art styles help to transport viewers into fantastic worlds that are both immersive and captivating. Additionally, anime has a significant cultural influence, introducing viewers to Japanese customs, traditions, and way of life, which adds to its popularity.

p3_questions.question: Do you think films with famous actors or actresses are more popular?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, I do. This is because these actors and actresses have large fan bases, and people often watch their movies simply because they admire them. Their popularity also attracts media attention and creates hype, leading to greater publicity for the movie. Additionally, famous actors and actresses are often perceived as talented and versatile, which makes the movie more appealing. However, this is not always the case as there are many other factors such as plot, direction, and cinematography that can affect a movie's popularity.

p3_questions.question: Are historical films popular in your country? Why?
p3_questions.answer: Historical films are quite popular in my country. This is because we have a rich cultural heritage with a diverse history that dates back centuries. Historical films provide an opportunity to relive our past and appreciate the struggles and sacrifices made by our ancestors. They also offer insights into our traditions, customs, and values, and help us reflect on our identity as a nation. Additionally, historical films are often visually stunning with detailed costumes, colorful sets, and dramatic scenes, making them an enjoyable and educational experience for audiences of all ages.

p3_questions.question: What are the different types of films in your country?
p3_questions.answer: In my country, there are many different types of films that people enjoy watching. Some of the most popular genres include action, romance, comedy, drama, horror, and animation. We also have historical movies that depict important moments in our country's history, as well as documentaries that explore different topics such as science, politics, and social issues. In recent years, there has also been a growing interest in independent and art-house films, which offer alternative perspectives and unique storytelling styles. Overall, there's something for everyone when it comes to films in my country, and people have a wide range of options to choose from depending on their interests and preferences. 6. Do you believe movie reviews I believe that reviews can be helpful in providing some insight and information about a film, especially if I'm considering watching something new. However, I also think that personal taste plays a big role in determining whether someone likes a movie or not. So while reviews can be a useful guide, ultimately it's up to each individual to decide what they like based on their own preferences and experiences. That’s why it's always good to take reviews with a grain of salt and why you should try to get a sense of multiple opinions before making a decision about whether to watch a movie or not.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe an occasion when you were not allowed to use your mobile phone
you_should_say: When it was Where it was
Why you were not allowed to use your mobile phone
And how you felt about it
topics.summary_zh: 三周前，我在市中心老牌剧院看古典音乐现场音乐会时被禁用手机。剧院为保持安静、不打扰演奏者和观众，要求大家全程关机。起初我因长时间关机感到不适，还担心会无聊，却在音乐会开始后沉浸在乐曲中，全程无干扰地享受音乐，最后觉得这个规定十分合理。
topics.sample_en: An occasion I couldn’t use my mobile phone was three weeks ago, when I went to watch a live classical music concert at a city theatre. It’s a famous old theatre in the downtown area, with a quiet and elegant atmosphere, and there were about 500 audience members that night. The reason for the phone ban was that the theatre has a strict rule to keep the concert hall quiet. The staff said any phone ring or screen light would break the peaceful mood and disturb both the musicians on stage and the other audience. We were told to turn off our phones completely and not even keep them on vibrate during the whole concert. At first, I felt a little uncomfortable because I never turn off my phone for such a long time. I also thought it would be a bit dull without my phone to pass the time if I got bored. But as the concert started, I was totally drawn into the beautiful music. Without phone distractions, I could enjoy every note fully. I left the theatre feeling really relaxed and happy, and I thought the phone ban was a great rule to respect the artists and the music.

p3_questions.question: Do you think it is necessary to have laws on the use of mobile phones?
p3_questions.answer: Yes I think it is necessary to have laws on the use of mobile phones. Most importantly, there should be laws and regulations to restrict the camera function. Nowadays, there are a lot of sneak shots happening, such as in the subway, elevator and bus. These phenomena happen continuously because we do not have laws to restrict them. If the law regulates that the camera of a mobile phone must make a sound when taking pictures this will eliminate many sneak shots. I know that this legal requirement exists in Japan, so the camera of a mobile phone bought in Japan cannot be muted. Of course there are still many places where the use of mobile phones needs to be restricted by law with more than just cameras.

p3_questions.question: Is it a waste of time to take pictures with mobile phones?
p3_questions.answer: Well, personally, I don't think it’s a waste of time to take pictures with mobile phones. Actually, I think that’s the main function people use with phones except for social networking. Before the emergence of mobile phone cameras, people could only take photos with card cameras, not even digital ones. When you wanted to take a photo you could only take the camera out first and adjusted the camera's exposure and focus according to the light and background. After taking the photo you couldn't read it. You had to wait for the photo to be developed in the photo studio before you could view it. With the camera function of mobile phones, people's lives are greatly facilitated. Now we only need to click on the phone to take photos and videos and we can also instantly view or delete the photos we don’t like. This is not a waste of time.

p3_questions.question: What positive and negative impact do mobile phones have on friendships?
p3_questions.answer: The simplest summary of the positive impact of mobile phones on friendships is convenience. That means people can communicate with friends anytime and anywhere, including voice messages, text messages and video communications. Even if two people are separated from each other, as long as there is a network, they can be connected at any time. But the negative impact is that some people rely too much on mobile phones and they can talk freely with their friends in the online world, but when they arrive in the real world they become nervous and don’t know how to do face-to-face communication.

p3_questions.question: How do young and old people use mobile phones differently?
p3_questions.answer: Most of the elderly are not familiar with using new smart phones, so most of them are still using old- fashioned phones without the function of getting online. Being able to make calls to find relatives and children is their greatest need for mobile phones. On the contrary, the lives of young people can be said to be based entirely on mobile phones. We use our mobile phones to watch videos, play games, get information, order food, and even make friends. Everything can be done on a mobile phone, so phones have become an indispensable part of young people’s lives.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe an occasion when many people were smiling
you_should_say: Who you were with What happened
And explain why most people were smiling
topics.summary_zh: 三个月前初秋周日上午，我和父母去城市公园，这里举办了小型狗狗秀，现场有不少市民。各类狗狗表演趣味特技，一只小金毛获评最萌小狗，画面温馨又有趣。大家面带笑容，因狗狗的可爱模样、宠物与主人的暖心羁绊，再加上舒适的秋景，让所有人都沉浸在轻松愉悦的氛围里，满是欢喜。
topics.sample_en: An occasion when many people were smiling was three months ago, on a Sunday morning in early autumn. I was with my parents, and we went to the city park near our home—there were lots of people there, like young couples, families with kids, and groups of friends, all enjoying the nice weather. That day, the park held a small dog show for local pet owners. Different kinds of dogs did cute tricks, like jumping through hoops, shaking hands and even dancing with their owners. A little golden retriever won the "cutest puppy" prize, and its owner cried a little when she got the award, which made everyone laugh and smile more. Kids ran around clapping their hands, and adults took photos of the lovely dogs, all with big grins on their faces. My parents and I sat on a bench watching, and we couldn’t help smiling at the funny and sweet scenes. Most people were smiling because the dog show was full of joy and cuteness. The little dogs were so lovely and funny, and seeing the deep bond between pets and their owners was really warm. The cool autumn weather and the beautiful park also made everyone feel relaxed and happy. It’s easy to smile when you’re surrounded by such sweet and light-hearted moments, and all the positive energy made everyone feel good and show their smiles.

p3_questions.question: Do people smile more when they are younger or older?
p3_questions.answer: I think people smile more when they are younger. This is because being young gives unlimited possibilities, unlimited vitality and energy. When they are young, people like to party with friends, and even if they have troubles they can disappear as people chat and drink with friends. However, as time goes by young people become middle-aged and the pressure on them becomes greater. They need to work longer hours, need to take care of elderly parents and young children, and need to deal with various interpersonal relationships, so their smiles gradually disappear. When they are old, the passion is gone, most of their friends are gone and the children have their own families and cannot be with them. So older people smile less.

p3_questions.question: Do women smile more than men? Why?
p3_questions.answer: Well, I think so. First of all, I think women love to look beautiful. A smile can add to a woman's appearance and add a feminine charm. It's better to be in a photo with a big smile rather than having a crying or sad face. I think smiling women are more attractive. Secondly, girls generally act as mothers or as other gentle female roles and a smile is the easiest way to lower others’ defenses and make strangers more accessible. Men generally bear heavier social pressure, so they don’t like to smile as much as women. That’s why I think women smile more than men.

p3_questions.question: Why do most people smile in photographs?
p3_questions.answer: Well, I guess it may be because everyone takes pictures to have good memories. That’s why most people choose to smile in photographs because good memories should be associated with a smile. I have heard that scientists’ studies have found that people are the most beautiful when they laugh. I believe you can also see this in the mirror that the smiling face of yourself looks more kind and beautiful than the crying or sad face. So in photos that capture a beautiful memory, most people will choose a smiling face. However, some people think it's cooler not to laugh, it's just a personal choice.

p3_questions.question: Do you think people who like to smile are more friendly?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, I do think people who always smile are more friendly. To be friendly to people, we must first learn how to smile to people. We have an old saying in China that laughter is an “interpersonal lubricant”. If you can smile at people from time to time, you will naturally make friends. Smiling is a pleasant facial expression that can shorten the psychological distance between people and create a warm and harmonious atmosphere for in-depth communication and interaction. Research shows that people prefer and remember people who smile at them. So I think people who smile are more kind and friendly than those who don’t.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a natural talent (sports/music, etc) you want to improve
you_should_say: How you want to improve it
And how you feel about it
topics.summary_zh: 我深深着迷于小提琴这项天赋，这一切始于几年前与家人参加古典音乐会时，琴声一响便瞬间被其抒情的魔力征服。从此，我渴望自己也能奏出如此动人的旋律。
topics.sample_en: One natural talent that greatly interests me is playing the violin. I stumbled upon this passion when I attended a classical music concert with my family a few years ago. The moment the violinist began to play, I was mesmerized by the power of music to evoke emotions and convey stories. From that day onwards, I yearned to learn how to produce such enchanting melodies myself. To improve my violin skills, I have recently started taking lessons with a seasoned instructor. I devote several hours each week to practice different techniques, such as bowing and fingering, to enhance my musical proficiency. Additionally, I also study music theory to gain a deeper understanding of composition and interpretation. My aspiration is not only to play the violin proficiently but also to connect with listeners on a profound emotional level through my performances. The journey to refine my violin talent has been both challenging and rewarding. Despite the initial difficulties, the sense of accomplishment I feel when mastering a new piece or conveying heartfelt melodies fills me with immense satisfaction. I view each practice session as an opportunity for personal growth and self-expression, and I am excited to see where this musical journey will lead me in the future.

topics.name_zh: 鼓励别人做不愿做的事
topics.cue_prompt: Describe a time when you encouraged someone to do something that he/she didn't want to do
you_should_say: What you encouraged him/her to do
And explain why you encouraged him/her?
topics.summary_zh: 室友，不想自己做饭鼓励室友和我轮流做饭，不点外卖室友刚开始不以为然，说道理都懂，但实施起来会犯懒。但后来我提出我们轮流做饭，室友想想就同意了。第一，外卖不健康。第二，外卖开销太大。
topics.sample_en: I share a rented house (合租) in the city centre with another girl. She never cooks because she always says that it’s a waste of time. For instance, you need to prepare the ingredients and wash the dishes afterwards. It takes you one hour to cook what can be consumed in 5 minutes (吃饭五分钟，做饭一小时), so her alternative (她的选择) is to order takeaways. I think her argument makes sense, as work can get really busy sometimes which won’t leave much time for us to cook. But I still don’t agree with her ordering takeaways every day. She always complains that she never saves money (存不 住钱) and what’s worse, she even borrows money every month. Maybe she can’t see the problem, but I can see that ordering takeaways is definitely a huge expense (巨大的开销), so I decided to tell her about it. I presented two viewpoints to her. Firstly, she thinks cooking is a waste of time, but most of the time when she’s not cooking, she’s just watching TV shows. Watching shows can be relaxing but what harm would it do to take one hour out of a four-hour show to cook? Secondly, ordering takeaways costs twice or three times as much as the expense of cooking. She was surprised after listening to what I said. She said she’s never taken these into account (从没想过这些/从没算过这些账), so she did some calculations and agreed that takeaways take up at least half her wage every month. She thanked me for my suggestion and now she’s trying to cook more.

p3_questions.question: Do you think some people are better than others at persuading?
p3_questions.answer: Absolutely, some individuals naturally excel at persuading others, while for some, it can be quite challenging. For example, people with strong communication skills and emotional intelligence often find it easier to influence opinions. Moreover, experience and confidence play significant roles; a seasoned salesperson might be more persuasive than a novice. However, it’s important to note that persuasion isn’t just inherent talent—it can also be developed over time through practice and understanding others’ perspectives. Ultimately, the ability to persuade varies widely depending on personality, skills, and context.

p3_questions.question: What kind of encouragement should parents give?
p3_questions.answer: Parents should provide encouragement that boosts both confidence and resilience in their children. Instead of simply praising results, they ought to acknowledge the effort and progress made, which helps foster a growth mindset. For example, saying “I’m proud of how hard you worked” rather than just “Good job” encourages perseverance. Moreover, parents should offer emotional support during setbacks, reassuring their kids that mistakes are part of learning. Such balanced encouragement not only motivates children but also equips them to handle challenges independently, ultimately nurturing their self-esteem and determination.

p3_questions.question: When should parents encourage their children?
p3_questions.answer: Parents should encourage their children particularly during challenging moments, such as when they are trying something new or facing difficulties at school. For instance, if a child struggles with math homework, supportive words can boost their confidence. Moreover, encouragement is crucial when children pursue their passions, whether it's painting or playing sports, as it motivates them to develop their talents. On the other hand, constant praise without reason might backfire, so parents need to balance encouragement with constructive feedback. In essence, timely and sincere encouragement helps children build resilience and a positive attitude toward learning.

p3_questions.question: What do you think young people spend most of their money on?
p3_questions.answer: In my opinion, young people today tend to allocate a significant portion of their money towards technology and entertainment. For instance, many invest in the latest smartphones, gaming consoles, and streaming subscriptions to keep up with trends and stay connected. Additionally, some spend on social activities such as dining out or traveling with friends, which helps them build social networks and gain new experiences. While essentials like education and clothing are also important, the allure of digital gadgets and leisure activities often takes precedence in their budgeting priorities.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a time you needed to use your imagination
you_should_say: Why you needed to use imagination
How difficult or easy it was
And explain how you felt about it
topics.summary_zh: 去年夏天，我帮表姐为她7岁的女儿策划了一场“魔法森林”主题生日派对。由于预算有限，我必须发挥想象力，用卡纸、布料等简单材料将后院布置成奇幻森林，还设计了寻宝游戏。虽然起初感到困难，但最终效果很棒。看到孩子惊喜的笑容，我感到非常自豪，也意识到创造力能让平凡变得特别。
topics.sample_en: Let me share about a time when I really had to use my imagination — it was last summer, when my cousin asked me to help plan a surprise birthday party for her 7-year-old daughter, Lily. The theme was “magical forest adventure,” but we had a very limited budget. That’s why I needed to use my imagination — we couldn’t afford fancy decorations or a professional designer. I had to think of creative ways to turn their small backyard into an enchanted woodland. It wasn’t easy at first. I spent a whole evening just staring at plain cardboard and colored paper, feeling a bit stuck. But once I started searching online for DIY ideas and remembering things from children’s storybooks, it became much easier. We made trees out of rolled-up brown paper, hung paper butterflies from strings, and used green cloth to create “magic grass.” I even designed a simple treasure hunt with clues written as riddles. In the end, I felt really proud and happy. Seeing Lily’s wide eyes and big smile when she entered the “forest” made all the effort worth it. It reminded me that imagination isn’t just for artists or writers — it’s something we can all use to create special moments, even with very little money. That experience made me feel more confident in my own creativity.

p3_questions.question: What subjects are helpful for children's imaginations?
p3_questions.answer: I think art is the best when it comes to stimulating children's imaginations. For example, if you let children play the piano, they have to imagine what a piece of music is about. Is it about a peaceful garden? Or is it about a noisy market? In order to play it better children have to depict a picture in their minds. Apart from playing an instrument, let's talk about drawing. Children can turn their imaginative world into reality just by drawing it on a piece of paper. Also, when they are painting, children have to decide which color should be used on which part of the drawing. By doing this, children's imaginations can be significantly boosted.

p3_questions.question: What kinds of jobs require imagination?
p3_questions.answer: I suppose jobs that require a great deal of creativity need imagination, for example, writers. As a writer, you have to make up many stories every day. Without imagination, your stories will be just like ordinary life. And readers don't like this, right? Readers like a fantastic world which cannot exist in reality, such as the magic world in Harry Potter. I bet J. K. Rowling’s imagination is exceedingly brilliant. Apart from writers, I think artists also need imagination. For painters, without imagination their work will be dull.

p3_questions.question: Do you think imagination is essential for scientists ?
p3_questions.answer: I suppose imagination is important for scientists, but I don't think it's essential. For one thing, imagination is important because sometimes if you don't have imagination, you will not think boldly. As a result, you will not discover new methods or new materials, and your experiments will come to an end. For another, I don't think imagination is essential or necessary, because just by conducting experiments over and over again without imagination, scientists can also discover facts.

p3_questions.question: Do you think adults can have lots of imagination?
p3_questions.answer: Well, for me I do think adults can also have lots of imagination, just like children. For example, you know many childrens’-story writers are adults, right? They are full of imagination and they can make up fantastic stories which are crazily loved by children. However, I still think that many adults lose their imagination as they age. I don't know why actually. Maybe it is because adults know more about the world. They know more about truths in our real world compared to kids, so there is not much room for them to think boldly.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe the time when you first talked in a foreign language
you_should_say: And explain how you felt about it
topics.summary_zh: 我记得上初三的时候，我们学校和英国某机构对接，聘请了10位外教来任教，教我们地地道道的口语和发音。那是第一节外教课，我们全班同学都很兴奋地等待着外国老师，当他刚一进班门的时候，便热情地同我们打招呼，我们也用最基本的话回应。我是班级英语课代表，当时外教老师点名要我起来带头做自我介绍，我却开始慌了，因为我之前从没开口说过英语，我们只是一直在背单词，学语法。
topics.sample_en: My first time and experience of speaking English was actually a little bit funny. I was brought up in a small city in western China. I remembered it was the third year of my junior high school. The government decided to introduce(引进) some foreign teachers to teach the students how to speak native English. My school was in contact with a British Institute to recruit(招聘) 10 foreign teachers. My classmates and I were all expectant (期待) about them. Finally our first foreign teacher class began. We were all curious(好奇心) about the teacher, some students guessed that he was tall and white, with yellow brown hair. Then the door opened and he came in. He was very nice and energetic(有活力的). He said hello to us and then made a very brief self introduction. We said hello to him in reply. Then the teacher asked who the student representative of the course was(课代表). My heart beat so fast(心跳加 快) at that moment that I could hardly say a word because I was. So I stood up. The teacher asked me to make an example to the class by making a self introduction. I had never spoken English before because we were just memorizing words and learning the grammatical rules(语法规则). But when I looked into his eyes, I decided to gather up all my courage because I had to work as the leader. So I thought it over and made a good introduction. The teacher praised me for what I had done. It was a tiny thing though. I began to take an interest in oral English.

p3_questions.question: Do you think minority languages will disappear?
p3_questions.answer: I’m afraid so. The world is changing at a horrifying speed and everyone seems to be in such a rush. Hand in hand with rapid development comes elimination of minority languages. The interactions in the modern world between different countries are so frequent that languages of fewer users are destined to adapt themselves to the changes. If people only chase efficiency in communication without taking cultural issues into account, it is likely that minority languages will disappear.

p3_questions.question: Does a person still need to learn languages, if he or she is good at English?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, I think so. Firstly, it is unfair that every foreign language speaker is learning English just because it is a universal language while an English speaker could spare themself the effort in mastering a foreign language. Besides, most non-English speakers today are at least bilingual and they prove themselves more competent than people who speak only one language. Last but not least, you never know what will happen in the future. Mastering a foreign language helps you adapt according to the changing environment.

p3_questions.question: Which skill is more important, speaking or writing?
p3_questions.answer: It depends on the occasion. In an ordinary life scenario, speaking is more important. To give an example, you are in a supermarket and you are unfamiliar with the layout. Now if you want to find a certain type of snack, you probably need to ask someone for help. This is when you’ll employ your speaking skills. But if you are up to some professional work, like processing documents, collecting and collating files, etc., this is when writing skills matter more than speaking skills.

p3_questions.question: At what age should children start learning a foreign language?
p3_questions.answer: Well, since I’m not an expert in the field of linguistics, I’m just sharing my personal opinion here. The best age for children to start learning a foreign language could be 8 or 9 years old, and of course it varies accordingly. On the one hand, if children start learning a foreign language when they are too young, they will probably be confused by the difference between the native language and the foreign language. On the other hand, if they start to learn much later, it is possible that they are too accustomed to their mother tongue and as a result, it would be much harder for them to master a foreign one.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a book you read that you found useful
you_should_say: When and where did you read it
And explain your feeling about it
topics.summary_zh: 《穷爸爸，富爸爸》是由畅销书作家罗伯特·清崎所作的另类财富书。作者用自己的亲身经历讲述了富人如何教育孩子金钱的问题，而这些看似常识的关于金钱的观念和知识，确实穷人和中产阶级所没有的。可以说作者在此书中一语道破了“富人的秘密”。我是在朋友推荐下买了这本书。当时闲来无事，在宿舍里花两天时间一口气读完了。这本书激发了我对理财的浓厚兴趣。
topics.sample_en: Rich Dad Poor Dad is a money management(理财) book by author Robert Kiyosaki. The author uses his own experience to detail how the rich educate their children about money, and these seemingly(看上去) common ideas about money are really not available to the poor and middle class. In this book, the author lays bare the secrets(一语道破) of the rich. I bought the book on the recommendation of a friend. I happened to be free at the time, so I stayed in my dorm and ended up reading it all in one sitting. The book stimulated(激起) my interest in financial management. The author points to a huge difference among the poor, the middle class and the rich, in that the poor work for money, while the rich let money work for them. On this basis, the author further elaborates the definition and relationship between assets(资产) and liabilities(负债), and explains the financial skills and knowledge that everyone should know when you play with money. Since reading the book, my own wealth has not increased much, but as the saying goes: A man can lead a horse to water, but he cannot make him drink(师 傅领进门，修行在个人). This book has inspired me to put the skills I learnt into practice, and I feel very lucky to have read it when I was still young.

p3_questions.question: What’s the difference between paper books and e-books?
p3_questions.answer: Paper books and electronic books differ in many ways. Since paper books are physical, you will need a large bookcase to store piles of books, whereas you just need an electronic reading device for e-books. Besides, the ways to get the 2 types of books are different. If you search for a paper book, you may go to a bookstore or a library. However, it’s much easier to get an e-book as long as your device has access to the Internet, then you can have it almost instantly. Speaking of convenience, it seems that e-book sales always outperform traditional paper books.

p3_questions.question: What’s the difference between the reading habits of old people and young people?
p3_questions.answer: Young people often read with more flexibility. Often, they don’t have a whole day for reading. Facing the pressing challenges of work or study, young people often read when taking a break from the things they are tasked with. As a result, young people often read in a fragmented way and they usually focus on the general ideas of a book. In contrast, old people have lots of time for reading, so they are able to pay much attention to the details in a story. In addition, they usually prefer paper books to digital ones.

p3_questions.question: What are the types of books that young people like to read?
p3_questions.answer: As one of the young generation myself, I hold that young people are fond of novels with a complicated and mesmerizing storyline. The fact that young people are passionate about novels and fantasy elements in a story indicates that they probably prefer fantasies over reality. Therefore, I tend to think young people are in favor of adventurous stories with a setting in an imaginary world such as Lord of the Rings or Harry Potter, to name a few.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a person who like to help others
you_should_say: and explain how do you feel about him or her.
topics.summary_zh: 我的邻居王阿姨非常乐于助人。她在一所重点中学做了三十年的英语老师，今年刚刚退休。她还在学校任教时，就开始在我们小区办“英语角”，帮助孩子们学习英语。每周五晚上，她都会准时出现在小区的凉亭，和孩子们用英语聊天。现在她退休了，有了更多的空余时间，便在小区里开设了免费的英语班。她说她特别享受教书育人的感觉，当孩子们有了进步，她会有很强烈的成就感，她通过帮助别人找到了自己人生的价值。她的无私奉献深深的打动了我。
topics.sample_en: Aunt Wang, a neighbour of mine, is always willing to help others. In the past three decades, she had been an English teacher in an elite school. She just retired this year. When she was still a teacher at school, she established an “English corner” in our community in order to(为了) improve children’s English. Every Friday night, She would show up(出现) at the pavilion in our neighbourhood on time(准时) and chatted with children in English. I took part in (参加) this activity several times. To tell you the truth(实话说), it was awesome. Unlike boring classes at school, Wang’s English corner had a lively atmosphere(气氛活跃), where every one had more than one chance to speak English loudly and express himself bravely.(大胆表达自己) After retirement, she had more spare time, so she set up an English course for children in the local area, teaching them English totally for free.(完全免费). I asked her why she was always helping others all the time, and she told me that she particularly enjoyed teaching. Seeing how much progress her students had made gave her a lot of joy (为她带来很多欢乐) and a strong sense of achievement(强烈的成就感). Without those children, her retired life would have been pretty dull(虚拟语气). What was great about (…的好处是…) teaching was that it made her feel alive(感觉活着) as well as enabled her to find value in life(让她找到生命的价值). I was deeply moved(被深深打动) by her selflessness and came to realise(逐渐意识到) that there was nothing better than(没有什么比⋯更好) helping others. Aunt Wang has become my role model(人生榜样) and I have decided to help others just like her whenever I can.

p3_questions.question: Who should people ask for help,colleagues or family members?
p3_questions.answer: It really depends on the situation and the type of help needed. For work-related problems, colleagues might be the best choice since they understand the professional context and can offer practical advice. However, when it comes to personal issues or emotional support, family members are often more reliable because of the close bond and trust shared. Personally, I think balancing both sources is ideal; for example, I turn to my colleagues for career guidance but rely on my family for comfort during tough times. This way, I get well-rounded support tailored to different needs.

p3_questions.question: What kind of help do people need when looking for a new job?
p3_questions.answer: When searching for a new job, individuals often require various types of support. For instance, guidance in crafting a compelling resume or cover letter can make a significant difference. Additionally, advice on interview techniques and how to present oneself confidently is crucial. Sometimes, people benefit from networking opportunities or career counseling to identify suitable roles aligned with their skills and interests. Ultimately, practical assistance combined with emotional encouragement can greatly enhance their chances of success in a competitive job market.

p3_questions.question: Should children help their parents with household chores?
p3_questions.answer: Absolutely, I believe children should support their parents with household chores. Doing so not only lightens the family’s workload but also teaches kids valuable life skills. For example, when I was younger, helping my mother cook and clean instilled a sense of responsibility and teamwork in me. Moreover, sharing chores fosters closer family bonds since everyone contributes to the home's upkeep. In today’s busy world, it’s essential for children to learn that household tasks are a shared duty, preparing them for independent living in the future.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe something important that has been kept in your family for a long time
you_should_say: When your family had it How your family got it
And explain why it is important to your family
topics.summary_zh: 我家珍藏数十年的重要传家宝是爷爷的老钢笔，自上世纪 50 年代爷爷考上大学起，已留存 70 多年。这只黑色金属钢笔是太爷爷攒三个月钱买的毕业礼物，笔身虽有磨损、笔尖被磨光滑，却依旧书写流畅。它对家中意义非凡，象征着家族代代相传的治学理念，见证了三代人的求学路，重要文字皆由它书写，更承载着长辈的期许与爱，是家族的精神内核。
topics.sample_en: The important heirloom my family has cherished for decades is my grandpa’s old fountain pen. Our family has possessed it for more than 70 years, dating back to the 1950s when my grandpa was admitted to university, a rare opportunity for young people at that time. This black metal fountain pen was a graduation gift from my great-grandpa to grandpa, who saved up for three months to buy it from a local stationery store in his small hometown. The pen body is slightly worn with faint scratches, and the nib has been polished smooth by years of use, but it still writes smoothly to this day. It’s an irreplaceable treasure for our family for multiple reasons. Firstly, it symbolizes the family’s consistent belief in the value of education—great- grandpa gave it to grandpa to encourage him to pursue knowledge, and grandpa later passed it to my dad, who then handed it to me when I entered university. Secondly, it witnesses the academic journey of three generations; every important paper, letter and even my college application essay was written with it. Most importantly, it carries the silent expectation and love of our ancestors, reminding us to keep a humble and diligent heart in learning and life. It’s not just a pen, but the spiritual core of our family.

p3_questions.question: What's the influence of technology on museums?
p3_questions.answer: Through technology, museums can manage their collections better, and those who work in museums can be more productive. Besides, they can offer unforgettable experiences to their visitors and exceed their physical limits by using online distribution and communication channels. Many major museums in the world have introduced 3D devices to allow visitors to experience history virtually. By enhancing visitors’ experiences, museums will attract more and more visitors. So, I think technology has brought lots of benefits to museums.

p3_questions.question: What kinds of things are kept in museums?
