p3_questions.answer: Well, museums showcase many historical things, of course. Old possessions of emperor families are usually presented in musuems., such as pieces of delicate jewelry from a thousand years ago, or crowns worn by the kings and queens from history. Besides, important items of certain dynasties are also must- have pieces for a museum, like a bronze bowl made 2000 years ago. But apart from cultural treasures, we can also find other historical artifacts such as dinosaur fossils.

p3_questions.question: What's the difference between things valued by people in the past and today?
p3_questions.answer: In the old days when the economy was mainly supported by farming, families struggled to survive. As a result, I reckon they would have preserved simple items like decent plates, cups and other crockery because they were rare. However, in today’s society, products are mass produced in bulk in factories and you can basically buy whatever you want from the market, so people don’t care for precious goods as much. Instead, they value good memories with family and friends. Therefore, emotional ties have become especially important to modern people.

p3_questions.question: What things do families keep for a long time?
p3_questions.answer: I think usually things that have special meanings are treated with extra care in the family. For example, antiques, which are passed down from the previous generations, are often unique and have historical meanings for the family. So, of course the family will take care of it very well. Besides, for family specifically, if something can unite the family and help them stay connected, be it a book or a picture of a late family member, the family would certainly want to look after it too. And they will probably even present it on special family occasions.

topics.name_zh: 自行车/摩托车/汽车旅行
topics.name_en: A Bike, Motorbike or Car Trip
topics.cue_prompt: Describe a bicycle/motorcycle/car trip you would like to go on
you_should_say: Who you would like to go with
Where you would like to go
When you would like to go
And explain why you would like to go by bicycle/motorcycle/car
topics.summary_zh: 在考虑10月和朋友一起骑摩托车去城市近郊，因为骑摩托车让人感觉自由和放松，但现在中国很多城市禁止摩托车在市区通行，去城市远郊可以尽情体验骑摩托车的乐趣，放松心情，享受风景和美食。
topics.sample_en: I want to go on a big motorbike trip (摩托车骑行) with my cool friends who also have a passion (热爱) for the magic of motorbikes. You might wonder why I like such a sport as motorbike riding. Well, first of all, it is a kind of activity that is interesting and also releases stress. Secondly, I enjoy riding fast to create some kind of excitement, and it feels like I am in Fast and Furious, which is a famous movie where people drive very fast to race or battle. . We always ride our motorbikes on weekends around the city but we want to ride to the outskirts (远郊) for this trip. Traveling between the hills (小山丘) and enjoying the freedom and the sound of the motorbike engine would be so amazing. We want to do this not only because we would be exhilarated (兴 奋) by the running engines, but also because it is not that fun riding in the city. We cannot go fast otherwise (否则) we will be fined, which sucks (糟糕的), while in the remote villages where there are less people and cars, it makes sense! Most importantly, we deserve a relaxing journey and it would be a great motivation (动力) for us after a long period of working. Releasing the pressure and enjoying gourmet food (美食) on the road would be great. I honestly cannot wait to do it！. .

p3_questions.question: Do you think people need to change the way of transportation drastically to protect the environment?
p3_questions.answer: Certainly! Here’s a different take on the question with varied sentence structure and style:. I believe that transforming our transportation habits is crucial for environmental preservation. For example, embracing electric vehicles and expanding public transit networks can significantly cut emissions. However, it’s not just about switching modes; urban planning that reduces travel distances also plays a vital role. In essence, while drastic changes might seem challenging, they are necessary to ensure a sustainable future and improve air quality in our cities.

p3_questions.question: Which form of vehicle is more popular in your country, bikes, cars or motorcycles？
p3_questions.answer: In my country, cars tend to be the most popular mode of transportation, especially in urban areas where families prefer comfort and safety. However, motorcycles are widely used too, particularly among younger people and in congested cities because they are more affordable and can easily maneuver through traffic. Bicycles, though less common now, are still favored in rural regions for their eco-friendliness and low cost. Overall, while cars dominate due to convenience, motorcycles and bikes remain significant for those looking for economical or environmentally friendly options.

p3_questions.question: How are the transportation systems in urban and rural areas different？
p3_questions.answer: The biggest difference between rural and urban transport probably lies in public transportation. When designing for either an urban or a rural population, planners need to consider the types of public transport that will best suit the needs of the community. People living in densely packed cities typically have easy access to a network of buses, trains, and perhaps bicycles. Actually, we could even say that metropolitan areas are designed to make it relatively easy to get around without a car. However, in rural areas, instead of amenities being packed tightly into one downtown area, they are spread out. Most of the time, cars are the most effective way to travel from home to work, to school, or to the supermarket.

p3_questions.question: Do you think air pollution comes mostly from vehicles？
p3_questions.answer: Well I think passenger vehicles are a major contributor of pollution, producing significant amounts of nitrogen oxide, carbon monoxide, and other pollutants. And the hard truth is that, while knowing that cars and trucks are one of the leading causes of air pollution, we still use them every day. Actually, the usage of personal vehicles is increasing every year, especially in developing countries. I’m not saying there aren’t other contributors to air pollution - of course, factories releasing toxic fumes are also detrimental to our air quality, but perhaps, their emissions aren’t as severe as millions of vehicles on the road. 5. Do you think people need to drastically change their methods of transportation to protect the environment? In my opinion, changes are definitely needed but not dramatically. In my country, people have already fostered good habits in protecting the environment, as they have now chosen to take some environmentally-friendly public transport options like metros and buses. Moreover, electric cars and hybrids are pretty common to see on the street, so as far as I'm concerned, people nowadays need to discover new forms of energy that can replace thermal power. And if buses and trains are able to hold more people, this would be another step in the right direction.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a time when you felt proud of a family member
you_should_say: And explain why you felt proud of him/her
topics.summary_zh: 这件事发生在大约三年前，让我感到骄傲的是我的哥哥。他当时是一名快递员。有一天晚上下班路上，他看到一位老奶奶摔倒在路边，其他人没有理会，但他立刻停下来帮忙叫了救护车并陪伴她。后来老人的家属在社交媒体上表达了感谢。我为哥哥感到骄傲，因为他毫不犹豫地帮助了陌生人，展现了善良和正直的品格。
topics.sample_en: I’d like to share an experience that made me feel genuinely proud of my older brother. This happened about three years ago, when I was still in high school. My brother has always been a quiet and easy-going person. At that time, he was working as a delivery driver, which is quite a tiring job. One evening, he was on his way home after work when he saw an elderly woman who had fallen down on the side of the road. Other people just walked past, but my brother stopped immediately. He helped the woman up, called an ambulance, and waited with her until help arrived. It turned out that she had a health condition and could have been in serious danger if no one had helped her. Later, the woman’s family found my brother and thanked him publicly on social media. Many people in our neighborhood started calling him a kind person. What made me proud was not the public attention, but the fact that he acted without thinking twice. He didn’t hesitate or worry about getting into trouble. He just did what he thought was right. I felt proud of him because he showed strong character and kindness at a young age. He is not a rich or powerful person, but he has a good heart. That event reminded me that small acts of kindness can really make a big difference.

p3_questions.question: What do you think about children working hard just for grades?
p3_questions.answer: In my opinion, children working hard only for grades is quite common in China, but it has both good and bad sides. On the positive side, grades can motivate children to study and help them get into good schools. However, if grades become the only focus, children might lose interest in learning itself. They may just memorize answers instead of truly understanding the subject. This can also cause a lot of pressure and anxiety. I believe grades are useful, but parents and teachers should also encourage curiosity and a love for learning. A balanced approach is more important in the long run.

p3_questions.question: Do rewards help a child become better?
p3_questions.answer: I think rewards can be helpful, but it depends on how they are used. On the one hand, small rewards like praise or extra playtime can encourage a child to study harder or behave well. This helps them build positive habits at a young age. On the other hand, if parents always give material rewards like toys or money, the child might only do things for the reward instead of understanding why the behavior is important. So in my opinion, rewards are effective when used properly, but parents should also teach children about responsibility and inner motivation.

p3_questions.question: When would parents feel proud of their children？
Is it good to reward children very often? Why?
p3_questions.answer: No, I don’t believe so. Rewarding children for their good behavior can encourage them to behave well in future. However, in order to achieve this desirable result, we have to control when the reward should be given, and conversely, when it should not. If rewards are given too often then they will lose their value to the child and won’t reinforce good behavior. Basically, the child will take them for granted, and actually may think it unreasonable if they’re not rewarded for some small, trivial deed. Even worse, as they grow up, they‘ll want bigger rewards, which the parent will feel obliged to give. Ultimately the child will be spoiled and could behave worse than if no rewards had ever been given.

p3_questions.question: Should parents reward children？Why and how？
p3_questions.answer: Absolutely. I think rewards are very important in parenting. First of all, rewards can encourage your child to have good behavior. The way you respond right after your child behaves in a certain way makes the behavior more or less likely to happen again. Also, rewards can improve the parent-child relationship. When the parent gives a reward to his or her child, both the parent and the child feel happy. You are happy because your child has done something you like, and your child is happy because he or she is getting something they like. All in all, it’s a win-win situation for both parties.

p3_questions.question: On what occasions would adults be proud of themselves?
p3_questions.answer: Well, for example, I would say when an employee finally quits a job which has constantly crossed their boundaries - and if a better one is already lined up, their self-confidence will be sky high. By doing so, they will have embarked on a brand new journey since their efforts will have finally paid off. Maybe they’d suffered from insomnia or tolerated unfair treatment, but in the end, people will feel extremely proud of themselves if their long-standing wishes finally come true. The same can be said for parents who witness their kids’ growth. They would feel proud of both themselves and their kids, on whom blood, sweat and tears have been spent.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe an item on which you spent more than expected
you_should_say: How much you spent on it
And explain why you think you spent more than expected
topics.summary_zh: 两个月前我的笔记本坏了，不得不买一个新的。妈妈给我转了6000元。但是我看中了Surface的一款笔记本，标价9000。它的音质和流程度让我爱不释手。但我因为我一开始跟妈妈商量的是买6000元的笔记本，真的不好意思再让她帮忙。我使用了花呗信用贷款支付。
topics.sample_en: I bought a new laptop two months ago, which cost me a fortune. What’s worse is that I’ve ended up paying back the loan every month because of this impulsive purchase. What happened is that my old laptop broke down while I was doing my graduation essay so I had to get a new one immediately. I talked to my mother about it and she agreed to help. We made a deal that a laptop for about 6000 yuan would be good enough for me.(我们说好了6000元的电脑就很合适) I totally understand that my mother wished for me to learn to become a wise consumer and spend every penny rationally.(理性消费) To be honest with you, I intended to do that too, until I tried out the Surface Pro 7 laptop in the store, which was marked up for 9000 yuan. I was so in love with its outer design and its solid sound quality. Best of all, the system ran so smoothly! (最棒的是，系 统运行非常流畅) However, I’d already reached an agreement with my mother on the 6000 yuan limit. I was too embarrassed to ask her for extra money, yet I really wanted this laptop. I finally decided to borrow the money from Alipay. I did some math and knew fairly well that I would need to pay back about a little over three hundred yuan each month for a year. I thought I could easily handle this payment, but honestly, it’s difficult. Now I really regret this purchase! Why didn’t I just listen to my mum and get one in my price range?

p3_questions.question: Do people buy things they don't need？
p3_questions.answer: Yes, I definitely believe that most people have bought things that they probably never have, and possibly never will, use. I think the root issue here is consumerism. Wherever we look, we’re bombarded with ads of products, and information compelling us to buy something that "we need" which we almost certainly don’t. We’re living in an age where we associate material possessions with happiness. While they may give us a feeling of happiness, usually it’s short-lived and very shallow. Also, we are surrounded by information that suggests to us that in order to lead a comfortable and happy life, we need this or that, which again just increases the pressure on us to buy items we have no need for.

p3_questions.question: What do you think young people spend most of their money on?
p3_questions.answer: In my experience, I think the most popular shopping items for young people like myself would be clothes, music, electronic gadgets and I guess girls spend quite a lot on makeup and stuff like that. Apart from these consumer products, we also spend a lot of money socializing or going out, though more introverted types may spend more on their hobbies, a favorite sport or something similar. For example, I’m especially interested in Japanese cartoons so I spend a great deal collecting Japanese comics and cartoon models.

p3_questions.question: Do you think it is important to save money？Why?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, definitely. Actually, I think it’s very unwise to spend all your money and leave your bank balance at zero. You see, saving allows you to enjoy greater security in your life. If you have cash set aside for emergencies, you have a fallback should something unexpected happen. And, if you have savings set aside for discretionary expenses, you may be able to take risks or try new things. For example, what if you encounter an emergency such as a car accident and you need to pay a huge hospital bill? Without any savings, you’d find yourself in a very difficult situation.

p3_questions.question: Do you often buy more than you expect?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, most of the time I buy more than planned. You know, I usually only plan to go window shopping, but I actually end up buying all sorts of things that catch my eye! This especially happens when I go out to buy clothes. For example, I leave the house thinking of buying maybe just a T-shirt, but then I would come back with shoes and pants as well. But if it’s just groceries, I usually only get what’s on the list. So it depends on the store that I’m visiting, I suppose.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a time that you gave advice to others
you_should_say: And explain how you felt about the advice
topics.summary_zh: 天气逐渐炎热，我的舍友抱怨说出去跑步太热了，我建议他去游泳。游泳有很多好处，无论天气多热，你在游泳的时候总不会汗流浃背。她采纳了我的建议，现在我们经常一起去游泳。
topics.sample_en: The days are getting hotter. My roommate Linda complains that it is too hot to go running. She dislikes the feeling of sweat streaming down her back. Therefore, I suggested that she tries swimming. There is actually an indoor swimming pool in our campus. She does not need to worry about getting tanned. As far as I am concerned, swimming is the perfect summer sport: when the mercury (温度计) rises, what better way to cool off (清凉) than to take a refreshing dip (尽情畅游)? No matter how hot it is, you don't sweat when you swim, or you won’t notice you’re sweating. Besides, swimming isn't just fun and a great way to cool down, it's also very good for your health, and while you're splashing about (戏水), you're actually doing wonders for your body. First, swimming increases one’s flexibility. Water's buoyancy (浮力) reduces a person's “weight” by about 90 percent. Pool water's buoyancy counteracts the force of gravity(抵消重力), making swimming an ideal low-impact form of exercise that puts very little stress on those bones and joints(骨骼和关节承受 的压力很小). Moreover, swimming is a total-body workout. It targets everything from sculpting your back (背部塑形) to toning your arms (瘦手臂). Instead of buying lots of different pieces of exercise equipment to work specific muscles(锻炼某个肌肉), we just need to jump in the pool, and tone our whole body in a few laps. By the way, swimming is one of the few sports we can do throughout our lifetime. Unlike something like boxing or basketball, you won't need to "retire" from swimming. Linda took my advice, and now we often go swimming together. It’s the best sport for summer!

p3_questions.question: What are the problems if you ask too many people for advice?
p3_questions.answer: If you seek advice from too many people, it can become overwhelming and confusing. Each person might offer different opinions, making it hard to decide which advice to follow. Moreover, too much input could lead to overthinking, causing unnecessary stress. Sometimes, people’s suggestions may conflict, making it difficult to find a clear solution. Additionally, relying on too many opinions might reduce your confidence in your own judgment, as you become dependent on others rather than trusting yourself. Therefore, it’s important to strike a balance between seeking advice and making independent decisions.

p3_questions.question: What are the personalities of people whose job is to give advice to others?
p3_questions.answer: People who work as advisors often possess empathetic and patient personalities, as they need to understand and support others effectively. Additionally, strong communication skills enable them to explain complex ideas clearly. For instance, a career counselor must be approachable and insightful to help individuals make important decisions. Moreover, being open-minded and non-judgmental allows these professionals to create a trusting environment. In short, a combination of kindness, clarity, and emotional intelligence typically characterizes those whose job is to give advice.

p3_questions.question: Is it good to ask advice from strangers online?
p3_questions.answer: Seeking advice from strangers online can be a double-edged sword. On one hand, it offers access to diverse perspectives and specialized knowledge that one might not encounter in daily life. For example, joining a forum dedicated to travel can provide unique tips from global travelers. However, the reliability of such advice is often questionable since the source's credibility is unknown. Therefore, while it can be helpful, it's crucial to verify information and not rely solely on strangers’ opinions. In summary, asking advice online has its benefits but should be approached with caution.

p3_questions.question: Should people prepare before giving advice?
p3_questions.answer: Absolutely, preparation is essential before offering advice. When people take time to understand the situation thoroughly, their guidance tends to be more relevant and helpful. For instance, if a friend is facing career dilemmas, researching potential industries or job roles beforehand can make the advice more insightful. Moreover, thoughtful preparation shows respect and empathy, which strengthen the trust between the advisor and the receiver. Without adequate preparation, well-meaning advice might come off as shallow or misguided, potentially causing confusion rather than clarity. Therefore, investing effort before advising is crucial for effective communication.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a popular person
you_should_say: What he or she is like
Why you think this person is popular
How this person influences the public
topics.summary_zh: 从新闻里认识她的，她是第一位获得诺贝尔科学奖项的中国本土科学家、第一位获得诺贝尔生理医学奖的华人科学家。这是是中国医学界迄今为止获得的最高奖项，也是中医药成果获得的最高奖项。这对女性来说尤其不易，我觉得她太厉害了！
topics.sample_en: Speaking of famous person I'm interested in, I would like to talk about Youyou Tu, a scientist who came to fame last year, as she gained the Nobel Prize in Physiology(诺贝尔医学奖). Tu was born in 1930 and has been doing research in integrating(结合) Chinese and Western medicine for a long time. She successfully discovered and extracted artemisinin(青蒿素), a special element which has high effectiveness in treating malaria(疟疾). This is also the reason Tu got the Nobel Prize. I first came to know her because of the extensive domestic reports on her achievement. Even though China has an astounding(令人震惊的) population of more than 1. 4 billion people, there are very few individuals who are successful enough to be nominated for the Nobel Prize, let alone those who really get one. Thus, Tu soon became extremely well-known after she got the prize. Personally speaking, I am very interested in her. She is the first Chinese who got the Nobel Prize in Physiology, and this is also the highest prize that traditional Chinese medical field has ever received. I believe that all of the Chinese people are proud of her. In addition, as a female, Tu is definitely a mighty model for women. Her achievement strongly proves that women are able to be as outstanding as men and that gender should never be an excuse to deny anyone's talent and hard work.

p3_questions.question: Why do people want to be popular?
p3_questions.answer: People might desire popularity for various reasons. Firstly, being popular can provide a sense of validation and acceptance, boosting self-esteem. Secondly, it often creates opportunities for social connections and networking, which can be beneficial in both personal and professional relationships. Additionally, the desire for popularity might stem from the desire for influence and recognition, as being well-known can amplify one's voice and impact on others. However, it's crucial to balance popularity with authenticity to maintain genuine connections and self-worth.

p3_questions.question: Is it easier to become popular nowadays?
p3_questions.answer: In the digital age, the path to popularity has indeed taken on new dimensions. With the advent of social media platforms and influencers, gaining recognition seems more accessible. However, the definition of popularity has evolved. While one can garner followers online, establishing genuine connections and respect in the real world may prove more challenging. Therefore, the ease of becoming known today may be offset by the complexities of maintaining substantial relationships. It's a dynamic landscape to navigate, where visibility can be swift but creating lasting impact requires time and authenticity.

p3_questions.question: Do you think good teacher are always popular among students?
p3_questions.answer: Absolutely, I believe that good teachers are not always popular among students. While exceptional teaching skills can certainly lead to admiration and respect from most students, popularity can sometimes be subjective. For instance, a teacher who maintains high standards and holds students accountable may not always be seen as "popular," yet they are still highly effective in imparting knowledge and fostering growth. Therefore, the ability to strike a balance between being liked and being respected is key for teachers in ensuring a positive impact on their students' learning journey.

p3_questions.question: Is it important for a teacher to be popular?
p3_questions.answer: From my point of view, while being popular is a positive attribute for a teacher, it should not be the sole focus. What truly matters is the teacher's ability to inspire and educate students effectively. Popularity may lead to better student engagement, but it's not the only factor when evaluating a teacher's performance. A good teacher should be knowledgeable, approachable, and passionate about their subject. By prioritizing these qualities over popularity, teachers can make a more profound impact on their students' learning experience.

p3_questions.question: What are the qualities of being a good teacher？
Why are some students popular in school?
p3_questions.answer: There could be several reasons why some students become popular in school. Firstly, some students may have exceptional interpersonal skills, allowing them to easily connect with and be liked by their peers. They may possess qualities such as friendliness, empathy, and a good sense of humor, making them enjoyable to be around. Secondly, students who excel academically or participate actively in extracurricular activities tend to gain recognition and respect from their classmates and teachers, which can contribute to their popularity. Additionally, individuals who display leadership qualities, such as being confident, responsible, and fair-minded, often attract attention and admiration from their peers. Ultimately, popularity in school is multifaceted and can vary based on individual personalities, talents, and social dynamics within the student community.

p3_questions.question: What are the qualities of being popular？
p3_questions.answer: There are several qualities which make people popular. Firstly, popular people are always versatile but generally have at least one outstanding talent. For example, they may be good at singing, dancing, acting or sport. Secondly, they are also polite and kind. Every day, thousands of people observe their behavior through the media, so if they behave rudely or impolitely, they will leave a bad impression on people. There are also some other qualities such as knowledge, compassion and humour, which are typical of popular people.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe a famous person you would like to meet
you_should_say: How/where you would like to meet him/her
And explain why you would like to meet him/ her
topics.summary_zh: 想与美国前总统奥巴马见面，被他的演讲和推动社会进步的努力所吸引。他希望在奥巴马的家乡芝加哥一家安静的咖啡馆与他交流，了解他的领导经验和对全球问题的看法。奥巴马的谦逊、韧性及影响力令人敬佩，与他见面将激励作者的个人发展。
topics.sample_en: I would love to meet Barack Obama, the former President of the United States. My acquaintance with him began through his speeches and his efforts to bring about positive change in society. I became captivated by his charisma and ability to inspire and bring people together. If I had the chance, I would like to meet him at a quiet café in Chicago, his hometown. Imagine sitting across from him, exchanging ideas over a cup of coffee, discussing his experiences in office, and gaining insights into leadership and diplomacy firsthand. It would be an enriching experience to understand his perspective on global issues and the challenges he faced during his presidency. I admire Obama not only for his political achievements but also for his humility, resilience, and commitment to making a difference in the world. Meeting him in person would be an opportunity to learn from his wisdom and leadership style, which could inspire me in my own endeavors. I believe a conversation with him would be truly enlightening and unforgettable.

p3_questions.question: Why can some celebrities stay famous for a long time while some cannot?
p3_questions.answer: In my opinion, I deem that some people stay famous for a long time because they have brought positive influence to the society, while those who only stay well-known for a short period of time are those who have no social responsibilities and did not embrace any social benefits. For instance, a movie star can stay famous for his or her active participation in donations, which helps the society fight with inequality.

p3_questions.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of becoming a celebrity?
p3_questions.answer: For me, I think one of the biggest advantages of being a celebrity is that you enjoy a relatively high income compared to ordinary persons. However, being a celebrity also means that you will lose your personal life and privacy, because as a celebrity, everything you do will be observed and watched by the public, and this is, I think, the greatest disadvantage.

p3_questions.question: What influences can famous people have on the society?
p3_questions.answer: Famous people can have influence on society using their popularity, and they can benefit the society with that. For example, a pop singer can publicly advocate for volunteering and call on people to join him or her in volunteering activities. Since celebrities and famous people are known by many people, they can bring positive results to the society if they intend to do so.

p3_questions.question: How can people become famous?
p3_questions.answer: People become famous for different reasons. For instance, some people became famous because of a role they played in a certain movie in Hollywood, while others became well-known because of winning a football match. In addition, there are also many people who became famous after doing something stupid or funny, but those people usually don’t stay famous for long.

topics.name_zh: 第一次尝试的兴奋活动
topics.cue_prompt: Describe an exciting activity you have tried for the first time
you_should_say: Why you thought it was exciting
And explain how you felt about it
topics.summary_zh: 两年前我所在的话剧社在学校的礼堂排演过一部剧。我有幸参与其中，演清洁工一角。那是我首度登台表演。排练了两个月后，我们终于要登台。我一直觉得自己准备的很充分了，登台前还是紧张得心跳乱了节奏。一开始大家都很紧张，渐渐进入了状态后，越来越顺利。最后我们在大家的起立鼓掌中退场。我想这种兴奋与紧张交替的体验以后很难有。
topics.sample_en: One of the most exciting events I have ever taken part in is a drama "Dog at the Door". I was so honored to(很荣幸) play the role of a cleaner. The play was due to(按期) be performed on New Year's Eve in the theatre of our college. After two months’ rehearsal(排练), the day of the debut(初次登台) for most of us finally came. Everyone in the drama club appeared to be calm backstage, but the anxiety was mounting amongst us with time getting shorter. Though I felt that I was fully prepared, I was still aware of my racing heartbeat and my sweating palms. The crowd cheered loudly when we got on stage. Far from being uplifted(受到鼓舞), I was overwhelmed and my mind went blank. The other two actors and I said the wrong lines, but our partner was pretty sharp to cover-up for(为⋯⋯掩盖错误) us. As we were amateurs, it took a little bit of time to loosen up(放松). As the amateurs were getting better, the lead-role repeated our mistakes. But he was clearly more professional in turning it around. He continued his part with composure. I bet no one except those on the stage was aware of the wrong lines. Gradually, every one of us found our place and started to get into it. We exited the stage right in the standing ovation(起立鼓掌). I guess it might have been the once-in- a-life-time(难得的) chance for me to get on the stage, too memorable and exciting to forget.

p3_questions.question: Do you think that children adapt to new things more easily than adult?
p3_questions.answer: I believe children generally adapt to new things more easily than adults due to their innate curiosity and flexibility. I think that kids are often more open-minded and embrace change without hesitation. For instance, learning a new language or technology tends to come more naturally to them as they are fearless in exploring the unknown. In contrast, adults may have fixed routines or preconceived notions that can hinder quick adaptation. Overall, children's adaptability stems from their eagerness to learn and their ability to quickly adjust to unfamiliar situations.

p3_questions.question: Why are some people keen on doing dangerous activities?
p3_questions.answer: Some individuals are drawn to engaging in risky activities for various reasons. It could be to seek an adrenaline rush, challenge personal limits, or simply for the thrill of it. For instance, extreme sports enthusiasts often find that pushing themselves to the edge provides a sense of fulfillment. Moreover, adventurous pursuits can also be a way to break free from the monotony of daily life and experience a sense of liberation. However, it's essential to balance excitement with safety and consider the potential consequences before indulging in such activities.

p3_questions.question: Why are some people unwilling to try new things?
p3_questions.answer: Some people are unwilling to try new things due to a fear of the unknown. Stepping out of their comfort zone might make them feel anxious or insecure. Also, past negative experiences can discourage them from being open to new opportunities. For instance, if someone had a bad encounter when trying something new, they may become hesitant to explore unfamiliar activities in the future. Additionally, some individuals might prefer sticking to routines as it gives them a sense of stability and control over their lives.

topics.cue_prompt: Describe an unusual meal you had
you_should_say: And explain why it was unusual
topics.summary_zh: 跟朋友一起，去了川菜餐厅，吃了魔鬼鸡翅，体会到了健康重要性
topics.sample_en: There was a time when I happened to (碰巧发现) find a good friend of mine and we were both into chili . We were curious which one of us was better at handling chilli, we decided to try Sichuan food as a competition. . We went to a place which was famous for its monster chicken wings , in order to attract more people. The owner set up a rule :anyone who was able to finish a full plate could get another plate for free . Unfortunately , nobody ever accomplished (完成) the task , so we thought it was a perfect chance for us. Both of us were actually anxious when the chicken wings finally came. It looked like super hot with layers of red chili on top .(好几层辣椒). We had our first bite (第一口), I swore to God (发誓) it was hotter than I thought , I never had the same experience  before, it felt like there was fire in my throat(喉咙里有团火), we had to drop off(放弃) before we finished the whole plate , because we both felt the stomach pain which lasted for few days . It was really a special meal I had ever had, not for the unforgettable monster chicken wings, but because we realized the importance of our health.

p3_questions.question: Do you think having dinner at home is a good idea？
p3_questions.answer: Yes, having dinner at home is both affordable and clean. I also enjoy eating at home. Sometimes I would spend two to three hours to cook a delicious meal for my family. Although it costs me time and energy, I feel happy when my parents enjoy the meal. The meaning of having dinner at home reflect not only on the dishes, but also on the time the family spends together. The modern people are always busy with working, so the moment they get together at home to have dinner is precious. During the dinner, they can chat with each other, so eating at home makes the relationship among family members become closer.

p3_questions.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of eating in restaurants?
p3_questions.answer: From my point of view, there are many advantages to eating in restaurants. First of all, customers can relax and enjoy the atmosphere inside. When eating in restaurants, especially some western restaurants, the calm, peaceful atmosphere could help them loosen up and find some inner peace. However, eating in has some drawbacks too, the price is always higher than takeaway food, or eating at home, and tips should always be paid. What’s more, since the outbreak of COVID-19, it is much more convenient and safer to eat takeaway food at home, compared with eating in a crowded restaurant. Compared to takeouts, eating in restaurants provides a better dining environment for consumers. The service offered by waiters and the delicate furnishing can all make eating an entertaining and probably socializing occasion, instead of just food for food’s sake. You may chat with an old friend or enjoy a date in a fancy restaurant on a weekend evening. Such a kind of pleasure offered by dine-in is irreplaceable. However, eating in restaurants is often more time-consuming. By ordering food online, you just need to stay at home waiting for the delivery. Yet if you choose to eat in restaurants, in most cases, you need to spend hours traveling to the place, waiting for the cooking, and then going back home. Women, also need to dress up in advance and do their makeup.

p3_questions.question: Do people in your country value food culture?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, people in my country value food culture as it is deeply rooted in our history, traditions, and daily lives. Food plays a central role in social gatherings, family gatherings, and cultural celebrations, bringing people together and fostering a sense of community. Moreover, Chinese cuisine is renowned for its diversity, flavors, and regional specialties, reflecting the rich culinary heritage and culinary craftsmanship of our country. Additionally, people in China take pride in our food culture, passing down recipes, cooking techniques, and dining rituals through generations, preserving our culinary traditions and identity.

p3_questions.question: Do people in your country socialize in restaurants? Why?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, people in my country often socialize in restaurants as dining out is a common leisure activity and social gathering opportunity. Restaurants provide a comfortable and sociable environment for friends, family, and colleagues to come together, share meals, and engage in conversation. Dining out allows people to enjoy delicious food, celebrate special occasions, and create memorable experiences together. Moreover, restaurants offer a variety of cuisines and dining styles to suit different preferences and occasions, making them popular venues for socializing and entertainment. Yes, as I mentioned just now, a restaurant is an important place for people to build and make connections with other people. My parents always say “Today is a big day. Let’s go out and have a feast (盛宴)” on certain occasions like spring festivals or someone’s birthday. And the restaurant is the place where family or friend reunions take place. People talk about old stories and new things over food. I think it’s a beautiful thing that food can bring people together. We can place our orders, take pictures and then ultimately get our attention back to each other through a meal.

p3_questions.question: Why do people choose to eat out instead of ordering takeout?
p3_questions.answer: People may choose to eat out instead of ordering takeout for various reasons. Eating out offers the opportunity to dine in a restaurant setting, enjoy the ambiance, and socialize with friends or family. Moreover, restaurants may offer a wider selection of menu options, freshly prepared dishes, and personalized service compared to takeout or delivery. Additionally, dining out allows individuals to experience new cuisines, explore different dining experiences, and treat themselves to a special meal or occasion.

p3_questions.question: Do people eat fast food at home?
p3_questions.answer: Yes, people do eat fast food at home, especially when they prefer convenience or have limited time for cooking. Fast food restaurants often offer delivery or takeaway options, allowing people to enjoy their favorite fast food meals in the comfort of their own homes. Additionally, ready-to-eat or frozen fast food items are available for purchase at supermarkets or convenience stores, providing quick and easy meal solutions for busy individuals or families.

p3_questions.question: What fast food is there in your country?
p3_questions.answer: In China, we have Lanzhou noodles with beef on the top, fried rice and dumplings (饺子), etc. This food is served in a quick way, while the taste is good as well. It’s like, all kinds of restaurants that you see in China town can be found everywhere in this country itself, no matter if you are in a shopping mall or a food court. Besides, western fast food is also common here, such as KFC, MacDonalds and Burger King (汉堡王), which are frequently seen on the street. So in China, you can have plenty of choices if you want to eat alone and eat quickly.
